text:
olivia: Hey all  quick planning Q before I book a week in Amsterdam for customer workshops. Two parts: can I get an upfront travel advance for a high-cost conference registration + is there a separate per-diem for weekend days? Also curious about checked baggage fees on personal cards.

marco_people_ops: Short answers: yes on the travel advance (with approval), weekend days use the same per-diem rules (per-diem is daily, weekends included) unless meals are provided, and checked baggage on personal cards is reimbursable if it's for business travel and reasonable.

marco_people_ops: Process for advance: submit a Travel Advance request in the Travel Portal with vendor invoice/registration link and estimated total. People Ops will review and Finance issues the advance (usually within 5 business days). Reconcile with receipts in Expensify within 14 days after trip end. Max standard advance is $2,000; exceptions require manager + People Ops sign-off.

sophie_manager: I can pre-approve the registration advance if you share the invoice and cost code.

olivia: Good to know. For per-diem: does Redwood pay per calendar day or per overnight? I'll be flying in late Friday night and leave Sunday evening 1 is that 3 days or 2?

marco_people_ops: We calculate per-diem based on nights spent in the destination. Arrival and departure days are prorated at 75% each by default. Example: arrive late Friday (arrival day = 75%), Saturday full day (100%), depart Sunday evening (departure day = 75%) so total = 2.5 days at the country rate. If meals were included by the conference, mark those as "provided" and reduce per-diem accordingly or submit actual receipts instead.

greg: Checked bag fees 1 I have a bulky kit for demos and a bag fee each leg. Reimbursable?

marco_people_ops: Yes, checked baggage fees for business equipment are reimbursable. If it's above normal (e.g., multiple oversized crates), include a justification and manager approval. Keep the airline receipt for the baggage charge; if missing, attach the card statement line and a short note plus manager attestation.

olivia: Lost taxi receipt scenario 1 I sometimes forget to ask for paper receipts in Europe where some drivers only accept cards. What to do?

marco_people_ops: If the merchant provides an emailed or digital receipt, attach that. If you only have a card statement line, use the Lost Receipt Affidavit in Expensify and include manager attestation. For small amounts under $20 we can accept card statement + note without affidavit.

expensify_bot: Expensify: report "AMS workshop - Olivia" created by olivia 1 status: draft. Please attach vendor invoice for advance request.

olivia: Thanks, I'll upload the registration invoice and estimate hotel/nightly per-diem. Will tag Sophie for approval. :smiley:
